# CANDIDATE: VWAP_MEAN_REV_RIBBON_FLAT

**Filed:** 2026-09-05  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price deviates significantly from VWAP while the EMA ribbon is flat, mean-reversion to VWAP offers an edge. This occurs because flat ribbon indicates low directional conviction and low volume suggests lack of participation, making extreme VWAP deviations likely to revert as market rebalances.

## Mechanism

Enter long if price closes below VWAP by at least 1.5*ATR(14) AND the 9-,20-,50-EMA ribbon slopes are all between -0.02 and +0.02 (flat) AND volume is below its 20-period average. Enter short if price closes above VWAP by at least 1.5*ATR(14) under the same ribbon-flat and low-volume conditions. Initial stop at the opposite VWAP deviation level (e.g., for longs stop at entry + 1.5*ATR), TP1 at 1R (return to VWAP), runner trails using a chandelier exit based on 22-period ATR.
